mapper.select: SELECT s.tracking_token::text AS tracking_token, t.template_id, t.updated_at AS template_updated_at FROM send_log s LEFT JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id LEFT JOIN workflow_step ws ON ws.step_id = s.step_id LEFT JOIN template t ON t.template_id = COALESCE( CASE WHEN ws.config_json ->> 'templateId' ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN (ws.config_json ->> 'templateId')::bigint END, c.template_id) WHERE s.send_log_id = #{sendLogId}
SELECT body FROM template WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
SELECT link_id, original_url FROM track_link WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY link_order, link_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO track_link (template_id, original_url, link_order) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{originalUrl}, #{linkOrder}) ON CONFLICT (template_id, md5(original_url)) DO NOTHING
